promise: Hold global warming well below 2 °C and pursue efforts to limit it to 1.5 °C
who: 196 parties to the UN climate convention, Paris Agreement
outlook: Policies now in place lead to about 2.8 °C of warming this century.
note: The agreement refers to warming averaged over decades, so one 12-month figure does not show the limit has been passed. It sets no end date.

promise: End extreme poverty for everyone, everywhere
who: All 193 UN member states, Sustainable Development Goals
outlook: About 9% of people would still be in extreme poverty in 2030 on the current path.
outlook_source: UN Sustainable Development Goals Report 2026, Goal 1
promise_source: United Nations, 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, target 1.1

who: All 193 UN member states, Sustainable Development Goals
outlook: 510 to 520 million people would still face hunger in 2030 on current trends.
outlook_source: FAO and partners, The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2026
promise_source: United Nations, 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, target 2.1

promise: Cut deaths of children under 5 to 25 per 1,000 births or fewer in every country
who: All 193 UN member states, Sustainable Development Goals
outlook: 60 countries are at risk of missing the target.
outlook_source: UN IGME, Levels and Trends in Child Mortality: Report 2025 (key facts)
promise_source: United Nations, 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, target 3.2
note: The promise applies to each country. The figure shown is the world average.

who: All 193 UN member states, Sustainable Development Goals
outlook: At least 644 million people would still be without electricity in 2030 on current trends.
outlook_source: Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report 2026
promise_source: United Nations, 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, target 7.1

who: All 193 UN member states, Sustainable Development Goals
outlook: 79% of people would have clean cooking in 2030 on current trends (range 74% to 81%).
outlook_source: Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report 2026, chapter 2
promise_source: United Nations, 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, target 7.1

promise: Give 90% of infants all three doses of the DTP vaccine
outlook: Coverage in 2025 was 1 point below its 2019 level.
outlook_source: UNICEF and WHO, 2025 immunization coverage estimates (15 Jul 2026)

promise: Protect 30% of land and 30% of the ocean
who: Parties to the UN biodiversity convention, Kunming-Montreal framework
now_text: 18.45% of land and inland waters, and 10.03% of the ocean
now_source: UK government, citing the World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas
outlook: Governments could come close to the land target by delivering commitments already made; the ocean is much further behind.
outlook_source: Campaign for Nature, 30x30 Global Assessment 2026 (reported by Devdiscourse)
note: The figures count areas designated as protected or conserved, not how well they are managed.

promise: Triple the world's renewable power capacity
outlook: Additions would need to average about 1,200 GW a year from 2026 to 2030. The record so far is 693 GW, set in 2025.
promise_source: IRENA, Delivering on the UAE Consensus

who: Over 140 leaders, Glasgow Leaders' Declaration on Forests and Land Use
now_text: About 7 million hectares deforested, down 15% on the year before
now_source: Forest Declaration Assessment 2026 (reported by Down To Earth)
outlook: The assessment finds the world off track to halt deforestation by 2030.
outlook_source: Forest Declaration Assessment 2026 (reported by Down To Earth)
promise_source: UK government, Glasgow Leaders' Declaration on Forests and Land Use
note: The declaration is not legally binding.

promise: Negotiate in good faith towards nuclear disarmament
outlook: Down from about 70,300 at the 1986 peak. Stockpiles are rising again.
outlook_source: Federation of American Scientists, Status of World Nuclear Forces, 2026
promise_source: UN Office for Disarmament Affairs, Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons
note: Warhead counts are estimates. India, Israel, Pakistan and South Sudan are outside the treaty.

promise: Give 0.7% of national income as aid
now_text: 0.26% of donor countries’ combined national income
now_source: OECD, Preliminary official development assistance levels in 2025 (9 Apr 2026)
outlook: Four donors met it in 2025: Norway, Luxembourg, Sweden and Denmark. The share was 0.34% in 2024.
outlook_source: OECD, Preliminary official development assistance levels in 2025 (9 Apr 2026)
promise_source: OECD, Preliminary official development assistance levels in 2025 (9 Apr 2026)
note: Not every donor has adopted the target; the United States has not.

promise: Phase out the chemicals that destroy the ozone layer
now_text: Nearly 99% of ozone-harming chemicals phased out
now_source: UN News, reporting the Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion 2022
outlook: Recovery to 1980 levels is projected around 2040 for most of the world, 2045 over the Arctic and 2066 over the Antarctic, if current policies stay in place.
outlook_source: UN News, reporting the Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion 2022
promise_source: UN News, reporting the Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion 2022
note: The phase-out runs in stages and is still under way for some chemicals.

promise: Provide $100 billion a year in climate finance to developing countries
now_text: First met in 2022, at $115.9 billion. $136.7 billion in 2024
note: The total includes loans and private money mobilised by public funds.

promise: Halve the share of people in extreme poverty, from its 1990 level
who: UN member states, Millennium Development Goals
now_text: Met five years early. In developing regions the share fell from 47% in 1990 to 14% in 2015
now_source: United Nations, The Millennium Development Goals Report 2015
promise_source: United Nations, The Millennium Development Goals Report 2015
note: Measured against the $1.25-a-day line used at the time.

promise: Cut the death rate of children under 5 by two-thirds, from its 1990 level
who: UN member states, Millennium Development Goals
now_text: Fell 53%, from 90 to 43 deaths per 1,000 births
now_source: United Nations, The Millennium Development Goals Report 2015
promise_source: United Nations, The Millennium Development Goals Report 2015
